title: When More Parameters Hurt: Foundation Model Priors Amplify Worst-Client Disparity Under Extreme Federated Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2605.08992v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is increasingly used to fine-tune foundation models (FMs) on distributed private data. The community largely assumes that large-scale pretraining serves as a 'rising tide that lifts all boats' in federated settings. However, our experiments reveal that these powerful priors can hinder rather than help the most disadvantaged clients under extreme heterogeneity. Through controlled experiments on federated text classification, we compare worst-client accuracy between TextCNN (2.7M parameters) and DistilBERT with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA, 66M parameters) across four Non-IID heterogeneity levels. Under extreme label skew (alpha = 0.1), DistilBERT+LoRA produces a worst-client accuracy gap of 50.1% -- 56% larger than TextCNN's 32.2% gap, despite having 25x more parameters and extensive pretraining. Under moderate heterogeneity (alpha >= 0.5), the pattern reverses: the FM nearly eliminates the gap. We call this the F

translated_title: 当更多参数反而有害：基础模型先验在极端联邦异构性下放大最差客户端差距
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）日益被用于在分布式私有数据上微调基础模型（FM）。学界普遍假设大规模预训练在联邦环境中如同“水涨船高”，能让所有客户端受益。然而，我们的实验揭示，在极端异构性条件下，这些强大的先验知识可能会阻碍而非帮助最弱势的客户端。通过在联邦文本分类任务上的受控实验，我们在四种Non-IID异构程度下比较了TextCNN（270万参数）与采用低秩适应（LoRA）的DistilBERT（6600万参数）的最差客户端准确率。在极端标签偏斜（alpha = 0.1）下，DistilBERT+LoRA产生的最差客户端准确率差距达50.1%——比TextCNN的32.2%差距高出56%，尽管其参数量是后者的25倍且经过了大规模预训练。而在中等异构性（alpha >= 0.5）下，这一模式发生逆转：基础模型几乎消除了该差距。我们将这一现象称为F……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文发现，在极端联邦异构性下，参数更多且经过大规模预训练的基础模型反而会放大最弱势客户端的性能差距（比小模型高出56%），而在中等异构性下基础模型则几乎能消除这一差距，揭示了基础模型先验的“双刃剑”效应。
en_tdlr: Under extreme federated heterogeneity, larger and heavily pretrained foundation models amplify worst-client performance disparity by 56% compared to smaller models, while under moderate heterogeneity they nearly eliminate the gap, revealing a double-edged effect of foundation model priors.
